settings.kernel: Uhat(k)=4 pi (sin k - k cos k)/k^3
settings.bdg_cell: 2-site hexagonal primitive cell, origin on the inversion centre, sites at +-(1/6,1/6,1/4)
settings.gs_method: preconditioned L-BFGS on the energy (normalisation by rescaling) + Newton-GMRES polish; Galerkin plane-wave sphere |G|<Kpsi with alias-free quadrature (grid >= 4h+1); independent pseudo-spectral box grids for the orthorhombic cell
settings.bdg_method: plane-wave sphere |q+G|<Kcut, real-symmetric L(q), A(q)=L+2X; A=CC^T, K=C^T L C, eigh
settings.memory_note: largest dense BdG matrices Nb ~ 7.9e3 (K=50): ~0.5 GB each; observed RSS about 1.2 GB while building L, X; full-spectrum K=50 run estimated below 3 GB

convergence.note: primary = consistent Galerkin Kpsi=Kcut=50; rel diffs are (K - 50)/50-values
